RMKS/1. PURPOSE. TO ESTABLISH STANDARDIZED DEPLOYMENT READINESS
  REPORTING FOR ALL COMSUBLANT UNITS. THIS MESSAGE SUPERSEDES
  COMSUBLANT 061/26 AND PROVIDES UPDATED TIMELINES, A REPORTING
  TEMPLATE, AND VALIDATION PROCEDURES.

  REPORTING ACROSS SQUADRONS. THE UPDATED PROCEDURE IMPROVES DATA
  ACCURACY AND ALIGNS REPORTING WITH THE FORCE READINESS TRACKING
  CYCLE.

  TEMPLATE NLT 07 NOV 2026 VIA PRESCRIBED CHANNELS. UNITS SHALL
  COMPLETE DATA VALIDATION AND SQUADRON REVIEW BEFORE SUBMISSION.
  ACKNOWLEDGE RECEIPT OF THIS MESSAGE IN ANCHOR.

#1001
NNNN
BodyText:
1. PURPOSE. To establish standardized deployment readiness reporting for all COMSUBLANT units. This message supersedes COMSUBLANT 061/26 and provides updated timelines, a reporting template, and validation procedures.

3. ACTION. Commanding Officers shall submit the enclosed reporting template NLT 07 NOV 2026 via prescribed channels. Units shall complete data validation and squadron review before submission. Acknowledge receipt of this message in ANCHOR.

4. POINT OF CONTACT. COMSUBLANT N3 Readiness Division, DSN 312-555-0101, n3readiness@example.mil

5. ENCLOSURES.

    a. Deployment Readiness Reporting Template (Excel)

    b. Reporting Procedures Guide

    c. Frequently Asked Questions
